thread:
maya: Quick flag — our daily GPU breakdown has a recurring stream of small ~0.01-0.05 GPU-hour charges labeled `unattributed-project`. Started appearing 03/19 and they show up across infra, experiments, and playground buckets :eyes:

sandeep: Yikes. Is that the same label across providers? GCP or AWS?

maya: Mostly GCP so far in the billing export. Saw 120 rows in the last 48h with that label.

olivia: Could be a tagging pipeline regression when we collapsed project metadata during the nightly ETL. I pushed a change last week to unify label keys.

zach: @olivia can you check the ETL job logs? If the label key is missing we'll default to `unattributed-project` which matches this.

olivia: On it. Quick look: job run 03/20 02:15 shows 503 errors to metadata API for ~3m. I think the metadata fetch fallback returned empty tags.

maya: That would explain the cross-team noise. These small charges are screwing up daily budgets and alert thresholds (we had 7 alerts last 48h). Can we patch the ETL to set a conservative fallback like `team=unknown` and emit an event instead of silence?

olivia: Yeah, plan: revert the aggressive key normalization and add fallback. I'll open a PR and run canary.

sandeep: For immediate relief, can finance ignore `unattributed-project` in daily allocation and bucket it to a temporary holding chargeback to be reconciled later?

maya: Yes please. I'll put those charges into a holding ledger and we can reconcile after labels are backfilled. Need an owner to approve the temporary exception for alerts.

zach: I can own the ledger entry and the alert mute. I'll create ticket and add steps to backfill labels. Ticket will include the exact SQL to extract candidates.

zach: SQL I plan to use:
```
SELECT invoice_id, usage_start_time, project_id, sku_description, cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE labels IS NULL OR labels = '' OR labels LIKE '%unattributed-project%';
```

maya: Perfect — once we have that list finance will allocate to a holding budget `finance:temp-gpu-hold` and notify team leads to confirm reallocation.

sandeep: Also want to lower the daily alert sensitivity for tiny spikes < $0.50 since they're noise. Can we tune that after backfill?

maya: Agreed. For now: 1) olivia -> PR to ETL + rollback normalization, 2) zach -> ticket + ledger entry, 3) maya -> create holding budget and mute alerts for this label, 4) sandeep -> approve alert threshold tweak after backfill.

olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 :white_check_mark: running canary now.

billing-bot: Automated notice — charges with label `unattributed-project` totaling $18.42 in the last 48 hours have been earmarked for `finance:temp-gpu-hold`. Ticket #FIN-209 created.

maya: Thanks — I'll post a short note to #general about the temporary holding and ask any teams who see their GPU tags in the list to reply. :memo:

zach: ETA to finish backfill + reassign: 48-72 hours depending on team responses.

maya: OK — closing the loop here. If anyone sees persistent new ones after the ETL canary finishes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
